summary.text: Blaine Michael Perkins (born February 28, 2000) is an American professional stock car racing driver. He competes full-time in the NASCAR O'Reilly Auto Parts Series, driving the No. 24 Toyota GR Supra for Sam Hunt Racing. He has previously competed in the NASCAR Craftsman Truck Series, ARCA Menards Series, and the ARCA Menards Series West.

career.series: NASCAR O'Reilly Auto Parts Series (ex Xfinity)

summary.text:
Matteo Cairoli (born 1 June 1996) is an Italian racing driver who competes in the Deutsche Tourenwagen Masters for Emil Frey Racing.

A homegrown Porsche talent since 2014, Cairoli developed into one of the leading LMGTE Am drivers, and was FIA World Endurance Championship runner-up for Dempsey-Proton in 2017. He later won the 2021 24 Hours of Nürburgring for Manthey and took pole at the 2023 24 Hours of Spa. In 2024, Cairoli moved to Lamborghini to graduate to LMDh in the IMSA SportsCar Championship, and won once for Iron Lynx in ELMS as an LMP2 rookie.

summary.text: Noah Quinn Gragson (born July 15, 1998) is an American professional stock car racing driver. He competes full-time in the NASCAR Cup Series, driving the No. 4 Ford Mustang Dark Horse for Front Row Motorsports.

summary.text: William Steven Power (Toowoomba, Queensland, Australia; 1 de marzo de 1981), más conocido como Will Power, es un piloto de automovilismo australiano. Es dos veces campeón de IndyCar Series, logrando el campeonato en 2014 y 2022, resultó subcampeón en 2010, 2011, 2012 y 2016 y tercero en 2015 y 2018. Hasta 2025, ha obtenido 45 victorias y más de 100 podios, combinando IndyCar con Champ Car. Fue vencedor de las 500 Millas de Indianápolis en 2018, siendo el primer australiano en lograrlo, y segundo en 2015.
